wish: someone should make a tool that plots math equations in 3D
spec:
Plots any z = f(x, y) as a shaded, height-tinted 3D surface over x and y ranges you choose.
Type an equation (sin, cos, sqrt, exp, ln, ^, pi, implicit multiplication like 2xy), tap Plot, drag to rotate, pinch or buttons to zoom.
Does not plot implicit surfaces, parametric curves or several equations at once; extreme spikes are clipped and the range is shown.
notes: Own expression parser because the CSP forbids eval/new Function.
